title: HIF-1alpha regulates the proliferation and differentiation of mouse cranial base sphenoid-occipital synchondrosis chondrocytes via PI3K/Akt signaling.
authors: Liang, Cun; Yin, Shuhui; Yang, Zhenjin; Wang, Yingchao; Hu, Jiangtian; Gao, Guojie
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HIF-1alpha通过PI3K/Akt信号调控颅底软骨细胞增殖分化，属纯细胞生物学与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The cranial base synchondrosis (CBS) is a critical growth center in the craniofacial region, and its abnormal development can lead to various craniofacial deformities. In a hypoxic microenvironment, hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) is a crucial regulatory factor for cellular adaptation to low oxygen conditions. However, the role of HIF-1alpha in the CBS and its mechanisms regulating the function of chondrocytes remain unclear. This study aims to investigate the expression characteristics of HIF-1alpha in the CBS and its potential mechanisms in regulating mouse spheno-occipital synchondrosis (SOS) chondrocytes (SOSCs). Histological and immunohistochemical staining were utilized to observe the growth pattern of the SOS and the expression characteristics of HIF-1alpha in the SOS of 1-8 week-old mice. Chemical hypoxia simulation and siRNA technology modulated HIF-1alpha expression, and potential signaling pathways were detected through transcriptome sequencing. Results indicate that HIF-1alpha is expressed in all layers of the mouse SOS and is closely associated with cell proliferation and differentiation. In vitro studies demonstrate that enhancing HIF-1alpha expression enhances cell proliferation and matrix synthesis capacity, improves cell apoptosis, and enhances the expression of chondrogenic markers SOX9 and Collagen II while diminishing osteogenic marker RUNX2 expression. We found that with the upregulation of HIF-1alpha expression, the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway is activated. In conclusion, our study revealed that HIF-1alpha regulates the proliferation and differentiation of SOSCs by activating the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 颅底软骨联合（CBS）是颅面区域的关键生长中心，其发育异常可导致多种颅面畸形。在低氧微环境中，缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）是细胞适应低氧条件的关键调控因子。然而，HIF-1alpha在CBS中的作用及其调控软骨细胞功能的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨HIF-1alpha在CBS中的表达特征及其调控小鼠蝶枕软骨联合（SOS）软骨细胞（SOSCs）的潜在机制。采用组织学和免疫组织化学染色观察1-8周龄小鼠SOS的生长模式及HIF-1alpha在SOS中的表达特征。通过化学低氧模拟和siRNA技术调节HIF-1alpha表达，并利用转录组测序检测潜在信号通路。结果表明，HIF-1alpha在小鼠SOS各层均有表达，并与细胞增殖和分化密切相关。体外研究表明，增强HIF-1alpha表达可提高细胞增殖和基质合成能力，改善细胞凋亡，并增强软骨形成标志物SOX9和Collagen II的表达，同时降低成骨标志物RUNX2的表达。我们发现，随着HIF-1alpha表达上调，PI3K/Akt信号通路被激活。总之，我们的研究揭示了HIF-1alpha通过激活PI3K/Akt信号通路调控SOSCs的增殖和分化。
